title: CUET Prep practice paper: Geography, set 2

rights.statement: Every question in this paper was written for CUET Prep and is owned by it. It is not a previous-year paper and contains no question from any examination paper.

questions.stem:
Assertion (A): Shifting cultivation can be sustained at any level of population density.
Reason (R): After a few years the cleared plot is abandoned and left fallow so that forest and soil fertility can recover.

options.label: A
options.text: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).

options.label: B
options.text: Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A).

questions.stem: Two neighbouring countries have similar climate, similar resources and the same manufactured goods. They are likely to trade little with each other because

options.label: A
options.text: they produce similar goods and so have little to exchange

options.label: B
options.text: they have more differences to gain from

options.label: C
options.text: being neighbours, trade between them is automatically banned by international law

options.label: D
options.text: tariffs are always zero between neighbours

options.label: C
options.text: It reduces the importance of distance in communication

options.label: A

Consider the following statements about the development of human geography.
A. The exploration and description phase was linked with colonial interests.
B. The quantitative revolution stressed statistical methods.
C. Radical geography arose from concern about social issues and used Marxist ideas.
D. Humanistic geography ignores human experience.
Which of the statements are correct?

options.label: A
options.text: both regions are highly industrialised, with large passenger and cargo flows

options.label: B
options.text: the Atlantic is the narrowest ocean and has no ships, so aircraft have a clear sky

options.label: C
options.text: there are no airports in eastern North America, so planes fly over the sea

options.label: D
options.text: air travel is banned over the Pacific

questions.stem:
Read the statements about the stages in the growth of human geography.
A. Areal differentiation asked how and why places differ from one another.
B. The spatial organisation stage used statistical methods and models.
C. The radical approach was concerned with poverty and inequality.
D. The humanistic approach ignored human perception and values.
Which statements are correct?
The 'naturalisation of humans' refers to a stage in which

options.label: A
options.text: people use advanced machines to change the landscape

options.label: B
options.text: people with simple technology adapt to and are dominated by nature

options.label: D
options.text: nature is controlled completely by cities

questions.stem:
Consider the following about distribution of population.
A. Availability of fresh water attracts people to a region.
B. Extreme climates and steep mountains discourage dense settlement.
C. Industrialisation and urbanisation draw people to cities.
D. Population density is highest where resources are least available.
Which statements are correct?

options.label: A

options.label: C
options.text: the work needs special safety measures against gases and floods

options.label: D

questions.stem:
Consider the statements on India's foreign trade.
A. Exports earlier consisted mainly of agricultural goods and raw materials.
B. The share of manufactured goods and services in exports has grown over time.
C. Petroleum and crude oil form a large part of imports.
D. India has a permanent trade surplus.
Which are correct?
Eutrophication of a lake is mainly caused by

options.label: A
options.text: excess silt brought down from the mountains by the rivers in the monsoon season

options.label: B
options.text: run-off carrying fertilisers and sewage rich in nutrients

options.label: C
options.text: a sudden fall in the temperature of the water during the winter months

options.label: D
options.text: the entry of sea water into the lake

questions.stem:
Consider the following about rural settlements.
A. Clustered settlements have compact blocks of houses with fields around them.
B. Dispersed settlements are common in hilly and forested areas.
C. Dispersed settlements are typical of fertile plains where land is scarce.
D. Hamleted settlements have several units with the same name as the main village.
Which statements are correct?
Why is in-situ upgrading of a slum generally preferred to its forced demolition?

options.label: A
options.text: It improves housing and services where residents already live and work

options.label: B
options.text: It moves all residents far away from their places of work and their sources of income

options.label: C
options.text: It prevents any further migration to the city by law

options.label: D
options.text: It removes water and sanitation so that people leave
